sentences.en: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light.
sentences.zh: 他作为目击者前来作证，就那道光的情况进行陈述。

sentences.en: We are in commission concerning the protection of children's rights.
sentences.zh: 我们正在负责处理关于保护儿童权利的问题。

sentences.en: His words gave rise to doubts concerning his true intentions.
sentences.zh: 他的话引起了人们对他的真正意图的怀疑。
